title: POC Technical Lead - Senior Principal Consultant
description:
**POC Technical Lead, Applied AI**
**About The Role**
 WRL is looking for a hands\-on
 **POC Technical Lead, Applied AI** 
 to turn validated research hypotheses and enterprise business problems into working, measurable, and transfer\-ready AI prototypes.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of applied AI research, solution architecture, and rapid prototyping. Partnering with researchers, domain specialists, business stakeholders, and engineering teams, you will design prototype architectures, build end\-to\-end proofs of concept, evaluate technical alternatives, and determine whether a solution is ready to move into development.
   

  

 This is not a coordination\-only or presentation\-focused role. You will write and review code, integrate AI models with enterprise data and systems, build evaluation frameworks, and lead the technical execution of PoCs.
   

  

 Once a PoC is validated, you will prepare the architecture, code, evaluation evidence, technical documentation, and implementation recommendations required for Winfo’s Development and Deployment teams to productize and scale the solution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Translate research hypotheses and business requirements into focused, time\-bound POC plans.
* Define the minimum prototype needed to test technical feasibility and potential business value.
* Design end\-to\-end architectures for applied AI, generative AI, and agentic solutions.
* Build working PoCs using LLMs, RAG, agents, machine learning, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Compare models, frameworks, prompting strategies, retrieval methods, and architecture alternatives using measurable evidence.
* Build evaluation harnesses covering quality, groundedness, robustness, latency, cost, safety, and operational complexity.
* Integrate prototypes with representative enterprise data, applications, APIs, and workflows.
* Ensure that code, configurations, prompts, datasets, experiments, and evaluation results are documented and reproducible.
* Identify reusable components, technical patterns, and potential WRL accelerators.
* Produce clear technical handoffs for Development and Deployment teams.
* Coordinate contributions from AI, engineering, data, cloud, security, product, and domain specialists.
* Mentor AI engineers, POC engineers, and interns.
* Provide technical evidence for decisions to scale, revise, pivot, replicate, transfer, or stop a PoC.


 The WRL operating model progresses qualified opportunities through Research, POC, Decision, and Transfer, with the POC leadership role accountable for prototype architecture and technical handoff.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* Proven experience designing and building end\-to\-end AI or machine\-learning PoCs.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and modern AI development frameworks.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise integrations.
* Ability to convert ambiguous research or business requirements into a working prototype and measurable evaluation plan.
* Strong understanding of machine learning, generative AI, model evaluation, and software\-engineering fundamentals.
* Experience comparing models, technologies, platforms, and architectures using evidence.
* Practical knowledge of source control, testing, code review, containers, APIs, cloud platforms, and technical documentation.
* Experience working with researchers, software engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, security teams, and product teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, costs, limitations, and trade\-offs.
* Evidence of taking at least one AI initiative from concept through prototype and engineering or production handoff.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with OCI, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with MCP, multi\-agent orchestration, vector databases, knowledge graphs, MLOps, LLMOps, and AI observability.
* Experience integrating AI with Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience creating reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, or internal platforms.
* Exposure to healthcare, life sciences, BFSI, or other regulated industries.
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, patents, white papers, or developer communities.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small cross\-functional technical teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* PoCs answer clearly defined business and technical questions.
* Prototype results are measurable, reproducible, and supported by evidence.
* Weak approaches are identified before significant production investment.
* Successful PoCs are transferred with clear architecture, code, evaluation results, risks, and implementation recommendations.
* Reusable components and patterns are identified across customer use cases.
* WRL develops a disciplined and repeatable POC capability.


**Who You Are**
 You are:
   

  

* A hands\-on builder who also thinks architecturally
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information
* Disciplined about experimentation, evidence, and evaluation
* Able to distinguish a polished demonstration from a validated PoC
* Provider\-agnostic and pragmatic about technology choices
* Conscious of quality, latency, cost, security, and maintainability
* Effective across research, engineering, business, and customer teams


**Why Join Winfo Research Labs?**
 You will join WRL at an early stage and help establish how enterprise AI ideas are converted into validated and reusable solutions.
   

  

 You will work across frontier AI, customer innovation, technical experimentation, and enterprise architecture, with the opportunity to see successful prototypes move into real customer environments.
   

  

**Own the journey from validated research hypothesis to working, evaluated, and transfer\-ready AI prototype.**

title: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer
description:
Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Engineer
 





 Infrastructure \& Directory Services \| Healthcare Environment \| Full\-Time
 





 Position Summary
 





 We are seeking an IAM Engineer to own identity infrastructure and access lifecycle operations across the enterprise. This role is focused on directory services, authentication, and identity governance at the platform level — Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, and automated provisioning. EHR application security (Epic templates, security classes, user profiles) is handled by a separate clinical applications team; this role supports that team upstream by ensuring accurate, timely identity data and account lifecycle events but does not perform EHR provisioning.
 





 Key Responsibilities
 





 •      Administer on\-prem Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID: user and group lifecycle, OU structure, GPOs, hybrid sync (Entra Connect), and conditional access policies.
 





 •      Execute and automate joiner/mover/leaver processes driven by the HR system of record, ensuring same\-day deprovisioning of departed workforce members across AD, M365, VPN, and downstream systems.
 





 •      Configure and maintain SSO integrations (SAML 2\.0, OIDC) for enterprise and third\-party applications; onboard new applications to the identity platform.
 





 •      Deploy and support multifactor authentication and passwordless initiatives across employed staff, credentialed providers, contractors, and students.
 





 •      Support badge\-tap / fast user switching for clinical workstations (e.g., Imprivata OneSign) in coordination with desktop engineering.
 





 •      Maintain role\-based access models at the directory and group level; remediate access creep and orphaned or stale accounts.
 





 •      Run periodic access certification campaigns; produce evidence for HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and internal audit requests.
 





 •      Administer privileged access management for admin and service accounts, including vaulting, rotation, and session monitoring.
 





 •      Manage non\-employee identity: vendors, travelers, locum tenens providers, students, and affiliate users outside the HR feed.
 





 •      Monitor and investigate identity\-related security events; support incident response and inappropriate\-access investigations with Security and Privacy/Compliance.
 





 •      Document standards, runbooks, and workflows; contribute to the IAM roadmap and automation backlog.
 




 Requirements
 


 •      3–5\+ years in identity and access management or systems administration with a heavy identity focus.
 





 •      Deep hands\-on expertise with Active Directory and Entra ID in a hybrid environment.
 





 •      Working knowledge of SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.
 





 •      Experience deploying MFA and conditional access at enterprise scale.
 





 •      PowerShell scripting for AD/Entra automation and reporting.
 





 •      Experience supporting audits and access reviews in a regulated environment.
 





 •      Understanding of least\-privilege and HIPAA “minimum necessary” principles.
 





 Preferred Qualifications
 





 •      Experience in a hospital or health system IT environment.
 





 •      IGA platform experience (SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta Identity Governance, or similar).
 





 •      PAM tooling (CyberArk, Delinea).
 





 •      Imprivata OneSign or comparable clinical SSO.
 





 •      HR\-to\-identity integration experience (Workday, UKG, or Oracle HCM feeds).
 





 •      Certifications: SC\-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator), Security\+, CISSP, or CIDPRO.
 





 What This Role Is Not
 





 This position does not include Epic or other EHR application security build. Candidates will not manage Epic security classes, templates, or user records — that function is owned by the clinical applications team.
 





 Work Environment
 





 Hybrid/on\-site per organizational policy; participation in an on\-call rotation for identity\-impacting incidents (account lockouts affecting clinical operations, termination escalations).

 Are you looking for the next step in your career in economic development, strategic planning, or municipal leadership? Northern Alberta is calling!
   

  

 Imagine living in a place where the long summer days stretch into unforgettable nights, and the beauty of the Northern Lights dances across the sky above you. In this stunning, close\-knit community, your work goes far beyond reviewing development applications and administering policies. You'll help shape how our community grows, develops, and thrives for generations to come.
   

  

**Why Northern Alberta?**
**Endless Summer Days**
 Enjoy long, golden hours with vibrant sunsets that inspire creativity and rejuvenate your spirit. The area offers a variety of active living opportunities for everyone, including camping, quadding, snowmobiling, hunting, and fishing. High Level offers pristine lakes and rivers and is the gateway to outdoor adventures across Northern Alberta and the Northwest Territories.
   

  

**Breathtaking Northern Lights**
 Witness one of nature's most spectacular displays as the northern sky transforms into a canvas of colour and wonder.
   

  

**A True Sense of Community**
 Join a place where neighbours are friends and your work has a direct impact on the future of the community. Your planning expertise will help guide development, support responsible growth, and create opportunities for residents and businesses.

 Your work isn't simply processing applications. You'll play an important role in shaping neighbourhoods, supporting investment, implementing Council's vision, and ensuring the community develops in a thoughtful and sustainable way.

 Northern Alberta offers a unique opportunity to build a fulfilling life and career in a region rich with opportunity. High Level is alive with festivals, rodeos, sporting events, and recreational activities for all ages.  This isn't just a job, it's a chance to
 **live, plan, and thrive**

* Lead economic development and tourism initiatives that support business growth and diversification.
* Build relationships with businesses, investors, government agencies, and regional organizations.
* Research, prepare, and implement plans, policies, studies, and strategies that support economic and community development objectives.
* Identify, pursue, and administer grant and funding opportunities.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and recommendations for Council, Committees, and Administration.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, partnerships, and community consultation activities.


**The Full Job Description Is Available Here.**

 Your educational background includes a degree in Urban Planning, Economic Development, Public Administration, Community Development, Business Administration, Geography, Public Policy, or a related discipline. Membership with an economic development organization such as EDAC or EDA would be considered an asset.
   

  

**Your Experience Includes:**
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in economic development, municipal planning, strategic initiatives, project management, community development, or a related field.
* Experience leading and coordinating multi\-stakeholder projects.
* Experience preparing reports, funding applications, policies, and presentations for senior leadership, boards, committees, or Council.
* Experience working with municipal plans, strategic initiatives, and public engagement processes.
* Grant writing, funding administration, and municipal government experience would be considered strong assets.


 Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.

When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.


**What We’re Looking For...**
 You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

 40
